All right, will you...If I’ll tell you something, will you believe it? Jesus Christ healed you of that tumor just then. Stand up on your feet and be made well. All right, go home and pass it now. In the Name of the Lord Jesus. You setting next to her there (Uh-huh.), you believe with all your heart? You believe, accept this is God’s prophet, this...You do? You’d like to get over that hay fever, wouldn’t you? Is that right? All right, stand up and be over it. In the Name of the Lord Jesus accept your healing. Amen.
